Name: Chad Martin
Author: AurumRunar
Description:
[b][color=#ffffff][size=4]Description, Requirements[/size][/color][/b]
Alternative portraits of a manly Martin I made for my playthrough. Visual consistency mod for people, who use OhoDavi style portraits. You need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]SOSCA[/url]. Also can be used with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30482?tab=posts]Donut's SVE Seasonal Anime Portraits[/url].
